products.name: HCG LifeOS
products.summary: Gamified, local-first productivity: quests, realms, progression and daily missions in one personal operating system.
description: HCG LifeOS turns real work into quests organised by realm, with an XP ledger, levels, daily missions and a random quest generator.
It is local-first: data stays on the device, and HCG Connect sign-in and cloud synchronisation are planned as separate, founder-approved milestones.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.2.0 is in development. The development repository states that the core and macOS app have not yet been fully compiled or tested.

platforms.note: Native macOS app. The development target is macOS 14 or later; not confirmed for any release.

products.name: HCG Mail
products.summary: A multi-platform email client for existing IMAP and SMTP mailboxes, with secure credential storage and remote content blocked by default.
description: HCG Mail connects to existing mailboxes over standard IMAP and SMTP. It does not need Outlook, Microsoft 365, Exchange or an HCG account.
Connections are encrypted, passwords are kept in the operating system's secure credential store, and remote content in messages is blocked by default.
products.developmentNote: An MVP (0.1.0) is implemented in the development repository. Live-mailbox, SMTP and cross-platform verification are still open items.

platforms.note: Developed as a self-contained Windows x64 executable.
A directly distributed macOS version and a Mac App Store submission are reserved but not started.

references.note: public; tag v0.1.0-mvp exists but has not been supplied to HCG Store as an approved release

products.name: HCG ONE: Unleashed
products.summary: The native macOS edition of HCG ONE: simulated order-flow trading training for advanced traders.
description: HCG ONE: Unleashed provides a native shell, a simulated market engine, order-flow views and candlestick charts from 1-minute to daily timeframes built from simulated trades.
All market data and all trading are simulated. No order leaves the Mac. The development build has no sign-in, network connections, payments or licensing.

platforms.note: Development builds target Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Not confirmed for any release.

references.note: LifeOS uses this key for both 'HCG ONE' and 'HCG ONE: UNLEASHED'

catalogueNotes: HCG ONE (the existing iOS and web app) is a separate product and is not listed in this store yet.

products.name: HCG Executable Maker
products.summary: Import a project, inspect it without running its code, build it with the real toolchain and package it with SHA-256 checksums.
description: HCG Executable Maker imports a project as a ZIP archive or folder and inspects it statically, without executing any of its code. It then builds the project with the real toolchain, packages it for distribution and records SHA-256 checksums for every artifact.

.NET projects, including Avalonia desktop apps, can be built and packaged for Windows (portable or Setup.exe installer), macOS and Linux (portable preview). Android and iOS projects are handled by Mobile Build Studio when the required toolchains are present.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.2.0 is a pre-release (milestones M0.1, M0.2 and M0.5). Code signing and MSI packaging are not implemented yet.

platforms.note: Test suite and installer checks run in CI on Windows. No release supplied.
Test suite runs in CI on macOS. No release supplied.
Developed and screenshotted on Linux x64. No release supplied.

products.name: HCG RePrompter
products.summary: A native macOS prompt-engineering workstation that clarifies instructions for AI systems without changing their intent.
description: HCG RePrompter turns incomplete or unstructured prompts into clearer, better-organised instructions for AI systems. It preserves the user's meaning, requirements and constraints, and explains every change instead of assigning an arbitrary score.
It works with the user's own Anthropic API key and includes a deterministic, offline Local Formatting mode that is always labelled as non-AI.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.1.0 is a pre-release development build and has not been commercially released.
catalogueNotes: The HCG Development Tools classification is provisional and awaits founder confirmation.
